retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered layout featuring a black header with oversized white typography, a central flash-lit photograph, and a footer with contrasting serif text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition consisting of a solid black header containing bold white text, a central photographic panel showing a group on a brass bed, and a lower section with a white text banner and orange footer text.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of text-heavy bands and central imagery
High-contrast white-on-black header for immediate brand recognition
Central photographic subject framed by the horizontal lines of a bed frame
Color coordination between footer text and photographic highlights
coreInvariants: White rectangular text banner overlaying the center image
Presence of a parental advisory-style badge in the corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of figures sits centrally on a bed, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized white numeral and bold text in the top-left header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold header to the central image, then to the white horizontal banner, ending at the orange footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black bands at the top and bottom provide structural negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast values with low-saturation photography and high-saturation accent text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sturdy slab serifs and high-contrast transitional serifs
letterConstructionRules: Header uses a mix of vertical and horizontal stacking
Central banner uses a clean, high-contrast serif in all caps
Footer uses a rounded, heavy-weight serif with tight tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized numeral in header acting as a graphic anchor
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing heavy slab serifs for branding with lighter transitional serifs for titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif header style
Approximates the transitional serif used in the banner
Captures the heavy, rounded serif feel of the footer text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of four people sitting on a vintage brass bed frame with a pinkish wall behind them, using harsh 90s-style direct flash. Leave solid black bands at the very top and bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white slab-serif title in the top black band. Place a solid white horizontal rectangle across the center of the image with black serif text inside. Add orange serif text in the bottom black band.

verificationChecks: Is the header text white on a solid black background?
Is there a white horizontal banner across the middle of the photograph?
Does the photography look like it was taken with a direct flash?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not copy the exact logo layout
Ensure the parental advisory badge is a generic stylistic equivalent
postGenerationChecks: Check for three distinct vertical zones
Verify the white banner is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the orange text is legible against the black footer
Confirm the brass bed frame is a prominent visual element
recipe.reuseFormula: Stack [Black Header with Bold White Slab-Serif] + [Flash-Lit Central Photo with White Banner Overlay] + [Black Footer with Orange Serif Text].
